caption:
She gave a US engineering school $100 million. They renamed it after her family.

In October 2015, Indian-American business leader Chandrika Tandon and her husband Ranjan Tandon donated $100 million to NYU's School of Engineering, one of the largest gifts by an Indian-American in US history. The school was renamed the NYU Tandon School of Engineering in recognition. Chandrika Tandon was previously a partner at McKinsey & Company before founding Tandon Capital Associates. Decades after building her business career, she also won a 2025 Grammy for Best New Age, Ambient, or Chant Album, at age 70.

An engineering school now carries her name. Not because she studied there - because she decided it mattered.

Sources: NYU Engineering, American Bazaar (2015-2022)
